title: Let Me Transfer You (To The Right Department)
style: amen breakbeat funk, 140 bpm, chopped breakbeat, deep upright bass, jazzy keys, deadpan female call-centre vocal sample looping the title, transferring-call swooshes between sections, comedic chase-the-tail energy, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the kick, breakbeat satire
lyrics:
[Intro — receptionist voice]
(robotic female) Let me transfer you to the right department…
Please hold… transferring now…

[Verse 1]
Dialled the main line, got billing on the phone
Billing said sorry, that's not our zone
Transferred to accounts, accounts said no
Transferred to support, support said go

[Pre-Chorus]
Go to the website, the website said call
The call went to billing, the loop did its all

[Chorus]
Let me transfer you — transfer you — transfer you
To the right department, the right department, the right department
Let me transfer you — transfer you — transfer you
Three-three-six in the chain, the chain has no end

[Verse 2]
Customer care said try the help desk
The help desk said back to the front desk
Front desk said the front desk is closed
Use the form on the site that nobody knows

[Bridge — half-time chop]
I've been transferred so many times
I forgot what I called for, I forgot the crime
The transfer is the answer, the transfer is the goal
The transfer is the soft place where the question goes to die

[Chorus]
Let me transfer you — transfer you — transfer you
To the right department, the right department, the right department
Let me transfer you — transfer you — transfer you
Three-three-six in the chain, the chain has no end

[Outro]
(robotic) Thank you for calling… please hold…
(call drops)
(dial tone)
